# New renderings — odyssey-085 (17.306–408)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| τοῖσι δὲ καὶ μετέειπε Μελάνθιος, αἰπόλος αἰγῶν (whole-line speech introduction, 17.369) | "And among them spoke also Melanthius, the goatherd of goats:" | "And Melanthius, the goatherd of the goats, spoke up among them as well:" | "addressed" (reserved for προσέειπε / προσέφη), "answered" (reserved for ἠμείβετο), "goatherd" alone; built on the table's τοῖσι δὲ καὶ μετέειπε Θεοκλύμενος θεοειδής and αἰπόλος αἰγῶν "the goatherd of the goats" (17.247) |
| τὸν δ’ αὖτ’ Ἀντίνοος ἀπαμειβόμενος προσέειπε (whole-line reply-formula, 17.405; αὖτε + ἀπαμειβόμενος) | "Him then in turn, answering, addressed Antinous:" | "In answer Antinous said to him in turn:" | "answered" as a finite verb (reserved for ἠμείβετο), "Antinous alone" (that is οἶος, a different formula); joins the table's τὴν δ’ ἀπαμειβόμενος προσέφη "In answer … said to her" with αὖτε "in turn" |
| ἦ ῥα καὶ Ἀντίνοον ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα (whole-line speech introduction, 17.396) | "He spoke, and to Antinous too winged words he spoke:" | "So he said, and turned to speak winged words to Antinous:" | "addressed" (reserved for προσέειπε / προσέφη); follows the shipped ἦ ῥα καὶ Ἑρμείαν, υἱὸν φίλον, ἀντίον ηὔδα (5.28) |
| ἀγακλειτῆς βασιλείης (17.370, μνηστῆρες ἀγακλειτῆς βασιλείης, of Penelope) | "of the renowned queen" | "of the renowned queen" | "glorious", "famous" (reserved for φαίδιμος, κλυτός); βασιλείη is "queen" (reserved for ἄνασσα in the vocative), and ἀγακλειτός follows the table's "renowned" |
| ἐπὶ οἷ καλέσας (17.330, 17.342; νεῦσ’ ἐπὶ οἷ καλέσας · Τηλέμαχος δ’ ἐπὶ οἷ καλέσας προσέειπε) | "calling him to himself" | "calling him to his side" / "called the swineherd to him" | "summoning", "inviting" (reserved for καλέω "invite" at 17.382–387) |
| δίφρος (of a seat, 17.330) | "stool" | "stool" | "chair" (reserved for θρόνος), "seat" (reserved for κλισμός), "chariot" / "car" (the other sense of δίφρος, as in the table's δίφρον ἐύξοον) |
| ἄρτος οὖλος (17.343, ἄρτον … οὖλον) | "a loaf, whole" | "a whole loaf" | "wheaten loaf" (reserved for πύρνος), "thick", "woolly" (the other sense of οὖλος); the note gives "whole" as the traditional sense |
| ἀρίγνωτος (vocative, 17.375) | "easily-known" | "well-known" | "notorious", "famous" (reserved for κλυτός), "conspicuous" (the note says the tone, sarcastic or not, is uncertain); the shipped 15.206 has "easily known" / "easily recognized" for ῥεῖα δ’ ἀρίγνωτος |
| ἀλήμων (17.376, ἀλήμονες) | "vagrants" | "vagrants" | "wanderers", "tramps", "beggars" (reserved for πτωχός); the same English as the table's ἀλήτης, the two words being told apart by context |
| ὄνομαι (17.378, ὄνοσαι ὅτι) | "make light of" | "make light of" | "blame", "find fault with" (each picks one sense of a word LSJ glosses both ways) |
| δημιοεργός (17.383) | "craftsman for the people" | "craftsman for the people" | "public worker", "skilled worker", "artisan" (loses δῆμος) |
| ἰητήρ (17.384) | "healer" | "healer" | "doctor", "physician" (Latinate) |
| κλητός (17.386) | "invited" | "invited" | "called", "summoned" |
| ἅζομαι (imperative ἅζευ, 17.401) | "shrink from" | "shrink from" | "fear", "revere", "respect" (each fixes one shade of a word that spans awe and dread) |
| μύθος ἀναγκαῖος (17.399) | "a word of compulsion" | "a compelling word" | "a harsh word", "a necessary word" |
| αἰδώς (of a beggar's reluctance, 17.347, 17.352) | "shame" | "shame" | "respect", "modesty", "diffidence" (αἰδώς also spans "reverence"; the note says only the reluctance to ask is meant) |
